title: The KV facade opens against the elicited binding on boot and emits facadeReady
asA: developer whose Worker or Node service needs a small durable KV surface behind a swappable boundary
iWant: one KV facade module to hold the Cloudflare Workers KV binding reference and expose typed domain verbs (get, getWithMetadata, put, delete, list), with a facadeReady lifecycle event on the first successful ready-check
soThat: the boundary between my domain and the vendor surface is the only place that has to move when the adapter changes, and boot ordering is observable via the event

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot, the facade opens against the elicited KV binding (env.CACHE on the fixture); once the ready-check resolves, a facadeReady event fires on the injected event sink with a payload of exactly {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp}. The facade exposes typed named domain verbs (get, getWithMetadata, put, delete, list) and does NOT re-export the raw binding.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Node or Worker process with the facade module imported and its factory invoked with the elicited binding
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the facade ready() call resolves
acceptanceCriteria.then: a facadeReady event fires on the injected event sink with the metadata-only payload; the facade exposes named domain verbs only; the raw binding is not re-exported
